name: Supplies and Studies
summary: At Kargath, Mus'hale asks you to recover stolen supplies and make rubbings of carved stones in the Dustbowl. The etchings are the study material Mus'hale lost when nearby ogres attacked.

sections.title: Lost Materials
sections.body: Mus'hale is recovering at the Kargath inn after nearby ogres caught the scholar in the Dustbowl. Before the attack, Mus'hale had found unusual rocks bearing carvings and made rubbings to study. Now the pack and those records are gone, so you are asked to search east and make fresh rubbings of the etchings.

faq.answer: Mus'hale is a scholar who found carved rocks in the Dustbowl and made rubbings to study.
Nearby ogres attacked Mus'hale in the Dustbowl, and Mus'hale woke under the innkeeper's care without the pack.

faq.q: What does Mus'hale want me to find?
faq.answer: Mus'hale asks you to search east for the stolen pack and make rubbings of the nearby stone etchings.
The unusual carved rocks are in the Dustbowl.

faq.q: Where do I return to Mus'hale?
faq.answer: Mus'hale is at Kargath, recovering under the innkeeper's care.
